page_title: ALA 2-1 ESP | Alaves v Espanyol 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Flag up against Ramon Terrats (Espanyol). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90+3' What was Victor Parada (Alaves) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+1' Lucas Boye (Alaves) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the left post.
87' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) picked up a yellow card from referee.
86' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Guillermo Cuadra lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
86' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a change. Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) replaces Yusi.
80' Substitution. Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) on for Pol Lozano.
80' Manolo Gonzalez is stunned as referee Guillermo Cuadra shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
78' The corner kick picks out Antonio Blanco (Alaves) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
77' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the right post from inside the box.
76' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Denis Suarez and he is replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Alaves).
72' Pere Milla (Espanyol) gets on the end of the free kick, but somehow sends his header well wide of the right post from close in.
70' It will be a substitution. Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is ready to enter the pitch as Ruben Sanchez walks off.
69' The ball is out of play and Alaves manage to earn a corner.
69' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Denis Suarez (Alaves) inside the box.
69' Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
69' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
68' Espanyol force a corner. They send men into the box.
68' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment.
68' Now Espanyol have a corner.
68' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
67' The foul by Denis Suarez (Alaves) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Guillermo Cuadra.
65' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) receives a pinpoint pass, takes one touch and produces a shot. It's a harmless effort, though, as it flies almost out of the park.
63' The attendance is 17149.
62' Manolo Gonzalez is forced to make a change. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ramon Terrats.
62' Substitution. Carlos Vicente (Alaves) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Calebe walks off.
62' Eduardo Coudet prepares a substitution. Toni Martinez is replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).
61' Substitution. Carles Alena is replaced by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves).
61' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) picks up an injury.

56' 2 - 1 Carlos Romero shows his great technique and produces a beautiful cross into the box. Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) gets on the scoresheet by heading the ball precisely inside the right post. It's now 2:1.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Espanyol.
52' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' What a big chance! Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Manolo Gonzalez gives a chance to Tyrhys Dolan and Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) is off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jofre (Espanyol) comes off for Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Victor Parada (Alaves) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
44' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
40' 2 - 0 Lucas Boye (Alaves) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Marko Dmitrovic with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
38' Pere Milla (Espanyol) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
37' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Espanyol comes to nothing.
35' Booking. Lucas Boye (Alaves) receives a caution from the referee.
34' Exposito (Espanyol) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
33' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
31' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
30' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
30' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Exposito (Espanyol) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Espanyol.
24' Pere Milla (Espanyol) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot at goal. His effort is blocked by Antonio Sivera with a brilliant diving save!
23' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
20' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the left post.
20' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
19' Espanyol earn a corner.
19' Jofre (Espanyol) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
18' Calebe (Alaves) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
15' Yusi (Alaves) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Marko Dmitrovic.

12' What an opportunity! Denis Suarez (Alaves) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes low towards the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
8' The goalkeeper makes a nice save to avert the danger from the free kick, which was executed by Exposito (Espanyol).
5' 1 - 0 What a hit! Denis Suarez (Alaves) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Alaves will take the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra is the one to supervise the game today.
